text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I did it...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I actually won. I won... the Queen
Elizabeth II
Cup.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I've finally become... a true princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: LET'S GOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess! Kawakami Princess
has
claimed first place!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess dashes off towards
the
winner's circle, her whole visage
beaming with
elation.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Eek?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Look—look! I came in first place!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I fulfilled my dream of winning the
Queen
Elizabeth II Cup!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Kawakami! You did it!
It was an
amazing race!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hey! You want to watch where you're
going next
time?! You almost knocked
over my trainee!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Urgh...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A's Trainer
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I'd heard the stories, but I guess she really is a brute! Does she have no dignity as a runner?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Over here, Kawakami Princess! That was
an
incredible race!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And now, it's time for an interview with
the victor!
Here's Kawakami Princess,
who simply dazzled as
she claimed first
place!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
So tell us—what emotions did you feel
the
moment you won the race and
ascended the
queen's throne?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It felt just like a dream, of course! I was
super
happy!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That's why without thinking, I...

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text: Oh, so that Umamusume is this year's queen. The one who came charging wildly into the winner's circle just now...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A's Trainer
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I'd heard the stories, but I guess she really is a brute! Does she have no dignity as a runner?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What are you acting all quiet for?

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You should be bouncing around all
happy like
you always do! You're not the
shy type.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You were gung ho enough during the
race at
least...

text_block_list.name: Lady in a Dress
text_block_list.text: Oh, is this year's queen friends with that problem child? Sigh... I guess there was good reason to be worried.

text_block_list.name: Lady with Hat
text_block_list.text:
Did you see how she behaved just after
crossing
the finish line? She roared like
some kind of
beast. It's as if she doesn't
know that this should
be a place of
elegance and grace.

text_block_list.name: Lady in a Dress
text_block_list.text:
Honestly... Her name is Princess, but she
doesn't
act like one at all—let alone a
queen.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (Have I... heard this before?)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(I wanted to become a princess like
Princess
Fighter. I've won the Queen
Elizabeth II Cup,
but...)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Wooooo! Princess! Smash through the
next race,
too! Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
What's with her? I can't believe it. She's
not
princess-like in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(If this were a race in Princess Fighter,
everyone
would be happy... but...)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Hey, where do you think you're
going?!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Um... She must be overcome with
emotion! What
a breathtakingly intense
race it was!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Is this really the princess I aspired to
become?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later that night, Kawakami Princess is
awfully
reserved despite having fulfilled
her long-held
desire to win the Queen
Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I-it's nothing! Ohohoho! Now then, let's
decide on
our next objective!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We ended up entering today's race
almost
immediately after the Shuka Sho.
Ideally, I'd like
to give her some chance
to rest before we begin
her senior year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A medium-distance G2 race on turf. It
takes place
in March, so she should be
able to handle it no
matter which G1
race she wants to enter during
the spring
season.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Th-that sounds great! The name makes
it sound
very, um, fun. So... when do we
get back down to
training?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzz... Bzzz...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look down at my phone's screen to see
the name
of the TV producer we spoke
to during the Shuka
Sho.

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text:
"Sorry to contact you so late! I'd like to
have a
serious discussion with you, but
I'd prefer to keep
it a secret from
Kawakami Princess..."

text_block_list.name: TV Producer
text_block_list.text:
"She's not... standing right next to you at
the
moment, is she? In that case, I'm
terribly sorry,
but..."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, d-don't mind me! I'll just wait right
here!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: It's fine! Don't worry about it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rattle...

text_block_list.name: Princess Fighter Character A
text_block_list.text:
"That was amazing, Princess! You're
everyone's
hope—a true legendary
warrior!"

text_block_list.name: Lady in a Dress
text_block_list.text:
Honestly... Her name is Princess, but she
doesn't
act like one at all—let alone a
queen.

text_block_list.name: Princess Fighter Character B
text_block_list.text:
"Look at how beautifully Princess Fighter
moves!
Who wouldn't be charmed by her
elegance?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A's Trainer
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I'd heard the stories, but I guess she really is a brute! Does she have no dignity as a runner?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No! No! No! I need to snap myself out of
this funk!
I just need to be more careful
next time...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Arrgh! Hmph! Yaaah! Hah! Hup!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: HIIIYAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thump! Rattle! Craaash! Flutter!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Uwah?! Ack, did I hit that box?! All the

documents are—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh no... I have to tidy all this up before
Trainer
gets back...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? This is...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Trainer! ...Oh? Why do you
look so
flustered?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Come ooon, you should know that a
princess is
very perceptive! I'll have to
pretend I didn't see
anything. ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You actually prepared a surprise
present for when
I win the Queen
Elizabeth II Cup. ♪ That's my
trainer—so
considerate. ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
This is... the surprise present Trainer was
hiding
from me before.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Glances around nervously...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer... but I could really use
this
pick-me-up right now.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
When the big reveal happens, I'll just act

surprised like I never saw it before.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Letters? And they're addressed to
both Trainer
and me. There are so
many—even more than the
fan letters I
get.
